session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trending Trading Range Day' with note 'which is also usually Bear Channel day' (filename mapped broad_bear_channel; on-chart title outranks per wave-0 rule -> trending_trading_range). Spans 3/22 13:00 through the 3/24 edge marker. Reading: buy-the-close gap up, High 2 bottom / truncated wedge at 4466 lifted price into the first shaded TR (07:30-09:30) with a descending Wedge-at-EMA and LH at 4493, the breakout below the wedge (10:15) transitioned into the second shaded TR (10:40-13:00) with exp-triangle dotted lines and a second Wedge at EMA top at 4472, the LH DT at 4467 failed and the breakout below the expilogue triangle (13:00) closed the day at 4447.
